label: tag-create-race: derived-tag pre-pass tries to create a canonical tag that a concurrent run already inserted; provider/TagCreate returns an 'already exists' error so the engine must re-resolve rather than duplicate

request.query: mutation TagCreate($input: TagCreateInput!) { tagCreate(input: $input) { id name } }
query FindTags($filter: FindFilterType, $tag_filter: TagFilterType) { findTags(filter: $filter, tag_filter: $tag_filter) { count tags { id name } } }
